faq_heading: The Crest condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in The Crest. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

The Crest, Burnaby: 6 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 20 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in The Crest fell from 7 in June to 6 in September (−14.3%), and 4 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 0.5% of Burnaby’s 1,333 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in The Crest?
The Crest also had 14 houses listed and 2 sold in September, against 6 condos and townhomes listed. The The Crest houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: The Crest home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

14 townhomes sold in The Crest with a median price of $1,135,000 (the middle half sold between $1,120,250 and $1,214,625), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 21% sold above list. They had a median $625 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $463 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in The Crest?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 condos and townhomes listed in The Crest. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is The Crest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in The Crest had a sales ratio of 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in The Crest from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 4 condos and townhomes sold in The Crest over those 4 months, out of 750 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in The Crest sell for?
faq.a: 14 townhomes sold in The Crest between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,135,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in The Crest?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.0% of the last list price (21% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
